content_sections.heading: EIL Associate Modellers Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: The 22 vacancies are distributed across six position codes based on discipline. Position codes ending in "1" are for Diploma holders (6 years relevant post-qualification experience) and those ending in "2" are for B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg.) holders (4 years relevant post-qualification experience), except Position Code C, which is open to Diploma in Chemical holders only. Reservation for Persons with Disabilities (PwD) is applicable as per Government of India directives; only candidates with 40% or more disability are eligible under the PwD category.

content_sections.heading: EIL Associate Modellers Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the educational qualification and relevant experience prescribed for the position code they are applying to, as on the cut-off date of 31 July 2026. Candidates must have obtained at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPI in the minimum educational qualification, and the qualification must have been acquired within the prescribed minimum course duration. The upper age limit for all position codes (A1 to F2) is 33 years as on 31 July 2026. Age relaxations available as per the notification: 10 years for Persons with Disabilities (General/EWS) 5 years for SC/ST candidates 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates 13 years for PwD-OBC (NCL) candidates 15 years for PwD-SC/ST candidates Relaxable for Ex-Servicemen (extent not specified in the notification)

content_sections.heading: EIL Associate Modellers Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration (inclusive of HRA and PF), which varies by the category of the posting city: Reimbursement of medical insurance premium for self, for insurance cover up to ₹2,00,000 per annum Reimbursement of out-of-pocket expenses for working beyond standard working hours Coverage under the company's GPAI Scheme, as per company policy Payment of travelling allowances for official duty travel outside the place of posting Paid leave of 2 days for each completed month, as per company policy All statutory benefits are subject to change as per applicable laws and rules.

content_sections.heading: EIL Associate Modellers Selection Process
content_sections.text: On the day of selection, applications and certificates will be screened to confirm eligibility for the post applied for. Only candidates meeting the eligibility requirements in full will proceed further. The selection process will be conducted at EIL's Delhi, Gurugram, Chennai, Kolkata and Vadodara offices for position codes A1 to F2. Candidates must report at 08:00 AM; the exact date and venue will be intimated separately by email. Depending on the number of candidates, the process may extend up to 08:00 PM and, if required, continue the next day, in which case candidates must arrange their own stay. Only candidates who have registered online and report with a printout bearing a valid registration number will be considered.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for EIL Associate Modellers Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the career link on the EIL website: www.engineersindia.com and complete the online registration. Read all instructions given on the website carefully before proceeding. Fill in the online form with correct details. Round off percentage of marks to the lower whole number (e.g., 60.9% becomes 60%) and CGPA to the lower decimal (e.g., 6.95 becomes 6.9). Keep scanned copies ready before starting registration: a recent passport-size colour photograph (JPG/JPEG, up to 75 KB) and a signature (JPG/JPEG, up to 25 KB). There is no need to post a printed application. Instead, take 6 printouts of the completed online application form, affix a colour photograph on each, and carry them to the selection process. Note that the cut-off date for post-qualification relevant experience and upper age limit is 31 July 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required at the Time of Selection
content_sections.text: 6 copies of the duly filled and submitted online application form with a recent colour photograph affixed Valid photo ID issued by the Government of India (Driving Licence/PAN Card/Passport/Voter ID/Aadhar Card) - original Proof of date of birth - Matriculation/Class X certificate or Birth Certificate - original Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets (Matriculation/Class X/HSC/Degree/Post-Graduation) - original Proof of norms used to convert CGPA/OGPA/CPI to percentage, where applicable Experience certificates for all declared experience, showing date of joining, date of separation and nature of work - original Supporting documents such as offer letter, confirmation order, pay slips, PF statement, ESI card and bank statement, if demanded SC/ST, OBC (NCL), EWS or Disability certificate in the prescribed format, if applicable - original Discharge certificate and related proforma for Ex-Servicemen, if applicable No Objection Certificate for candidates currently working in/under a Central/State/Autonomous Body, if applicable Candidates unable to produce a required original document to meet eligibility will not be considered for further selection.

faq.question: Q1. What is EIL Associate Modellers Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification (Advt. No. HRD/Rectt./Advt./2026-27/06) issued by Engineers India Limited for engaging experienced CADMATIC Modellers as Associate Modellers Group II on a fixed-term basis of 2 years, across Instrumentation, Piping, EWS, Structural, Civil and Equipment disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in EIL Associate Modellers Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 22 vacancies are available across six position codes (A1/A2 to F1/F2).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for EIL Associate Modellers Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 21 August 2026 at 2359 hrs. It opened on 7 August 2026 at 0000 hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for EIL Associate Modellers Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A relevant Diploma or B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc (Engg.) degree (with at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPI) in the discipline concerned, along with 6 years (Diploma) or 4 years (Degree) of relevant post-qualification experience in S3D/E3D/CADMATIC software.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for EIL Associate Modellers Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 33 years as on 31 July 2026, with relaxations available for SC/ST, OBC (NCL), PwD and Ex-Servicemen candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for EIL Associate Modellers Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the notification.
